receiver.target: Godot 4.7.2 GL Compatibility direct glTF skin import
receiver.target_mode: actual imported skinned GLB shaded by target-host deformed direction frames
receiver.reference_mode: exact owner positions with area-weighted indexed smooth normals recomputed after pose
receiver.stale_control_mode: exact owner positions with neutral 0-degree smooth normals reused after pose
receiver.position_control: unshaded target import versus exact owner-position reference

classification.pose_following_preferred_when: target shaded response is consistently closer to the pose-recomputed reference than to the frozen-neutral control after position-control alignment is shown
classification.frozen_like_when: target shaded response is consistently closer to the frozen-neutral control
classification.mixed_when: contexts disagree or position-control mismatch is too large to isolate direction-frame behavior
